## Problem

Which user/agent problem does this solve? Which ROADMAP phase does it belong to?

## Proposal

What should change (CLI, config, retrieval, adapter)?

## Benefit

Why is this better than the current behavior (relevance, trust, privacy, friction, interop)?

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why they were rejected.

## Impact

- [ ] Core change required?
- [ ] Adapter-only?
- [ ] Breaking config/JSON change?
- [ ] Docs/ADR needed?
